records.jp: 三人お揃いでどうしたの？
records.en_original: Why are you three here?
records.en_auxiliary: Why are you three here?
records.en: Why are all three of you here?

records.jp: 原種が出てきた時の感覚を聞きたくて
records.en_original: We wanted to ask if you felt anything when the Sephira appeared.
records.en_auxiliary: We wanted to ask if you felt anything when the Sephira appeared.
records.en: We wanted to ask how you felt when the Sephira appeared.

records.jp: 感覚？
records.en_original: If I felt anything?
records.en_auxiliary: If I felt anything?
records.en: How I felt?

records.jp: あなたは指輪をつける前から動けてた。<CR>すごく特殊な状態
records.en_original: You were able to move before putting on the ring. That's a very special situation.
records.en_auxiliary: You were able to move before putting on the ring. That's a very exceptional situation.
records.en: You were able to move before putting on the ring.<CR>That's an extremely unusual state.

records.jp: ねえ、どんな状態だった
records.en_original: So, what was going on?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what was going on?
records.en: So, what was it like?

records.jp: ……さあ？
records.en_original: ...Who knows?
records.en_auxiliary: Who knows?
records.en: ...Who knows?

records.jp: むー、秘密ってこと？
records.en_original: Aww, you're gonna keep it secret?
records.en_auxiliary: Aww, you're gonna keep it secret?
records.en: Hmm, is it a secret?

records.jp: そうじゃなくて、説明できないのよ。あの時の記憶が曖昧で、<CR>はっきりと記憶があるのは指輪をした後くらいだから
records.en_original: No, I just can't explain it. My memories from then are hazy, and they only clear up after I put on the ring.
records.en_auxiliary: No, I just can't explain it. My memories from then are hazy, and they only clear up after I put on the ring.
records.en: No, I just can't explain it. My memories from then are hazy,<CR>and the first thing I remember clearly is putting on the ring.

records.jp: 無意識で、本能のままに動いてたってこと……？
records.en_original: So you were moving unconsciously, according to instinct...?
records.en_auxiliary: So you were moving unconsciously, according to instinct?
records.en: So you were acting unconsciously, purely on instinct...?

records.jp: すごい。本当に強いフラグメントなんだね……
records.en_original: That's awesome. You must really have a strong Fragment...
records.en_auxiliary: That's awesome. You must really have a strong Fragment.
records.en: Amazing. It really is a powerful Fragment...

records.jp: それで？　まさかそれだけ？
records.en_original: And? Is that seriously all you're here for?
records.en_auxiliary: And? Is that seriously all you're here for?
records.en: And? Is that seriously all you're here for?

records.jp: う、うん。そうだけど
records.en_original: W-Well, yeah, it kind of is.
records.en_auxiliary: W-well, yeah, it kind of is.
records.en: W-Well, yeah, it kind of is.

records.jp: そんな無駄なことをしてる暇があったら、劇の練習でもしなさい。<CR>まだ台本も覚えきれてないんでしょう？
records.en_original: If you have time to waste, practice your acting. I'm sure you still haven't even memorized the script.
records.en_auxiliary: If you have time to waste, practice your acting. I'm sure you still haven't even memorized the script.
records.en: If you have time for something so pointless, go practice the play.<CR>You still haven't memorized the script, have you?

records.jp: ……ごめんなさい
records.en_original: ...Sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry.
records.en: ...Sorry.

records.jp: 主役がそんな調子で大丈夫なの？<CR>あなたが失敗したら全てパアなのよ
records.en_original: Do you really think it's okay for a leading actress to behave like this? If you fail, everything goes up in smoke.
records.en_auxiliary: Do you really think it's okay for a leading actress to behave like this? If you mess up, everything goes up in smoke.
records.en: Is it okay for the lead to be like this?<CR>If you fail, the whole production is ruined.

records.jp: ちゃんと毎日家でも練習してるんでしょうね？
records.en_original: You're practicing every day at home, right?
records.en_auxiliary: You're practicing every day at home, right?
records.en: You're practicing every day at home, right?

records.jp: まったく……話にならないわね……
records.en_original: I can't believe this... You're hopeless...
records.en_auxiliary: I can't believe this. You're hopeless.
records.en: Honestly... This is hopeless...

records.jp: も、もちろん覚えてるよ
records.en_original: O-Of course I've memorized it.
records.en_auxiliary: O-of course, I've memorized it.
records.en: O-Of course I've memorized it.

records.jp: そう――
records.en_auxiliary: Oh?
records.en: Is that so—

records.jp: 『何をしているの！　早くそのナイフであの男を！』
records.en_original: "What are you doing!? Hurry up and knife that man!"
records.en_auxiliary: "What are you doing?! Hurry up and knife that man!"
records.en: "What are you doing!? Hurry and use that knife on that man!"

records.jp: え！？　突然どうしたの？<CR>ナイフ？　あの男って……？
records.en_original: Huh!? What are you saying? "Knife"? "That man"...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?! What are you saying? "Knife"? "That man"?
records.en: Huh!? What was that all of a sudden?<CR>A knife? What man...?

records.jp: ……人魚姫の終盤部分の台詞よ
records.en_original: ...It's a line from the closing act of "The Little Mermaid."
records.en_auxiliary: It's a line from the closing act of "The Little Mermaid."
records.en: ...It's a line from near the end of The Little Mermaid.

records.jp: あっ……
records.en_original: Oh...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh...
records.en: Oh...

records.jp: やっぱりあなた、まだ最後まで覚えられてないわね。<CR>そのうえ、嘘まで吐くなんて
records.en_original: I knew it. You still haven't memorized the whole thing. Not only that, but you lied about it.
records.en_auxiliary: I knew it. You still haven't memorized the whole thing. Not only that, but you lied about it.
records.en: I knew it. You still haven't memorized the whole script.<CR>And on top of that, you lied about it.

records.jp: ごめんなさい……
records.en_original: I'm sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry.
records.en: I'm sorry...

records.jp: はぁー……
records.en_original: *sigh*...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*
records.en: *Sigh*...

records.jp: 仕方ないでしょ？　ライムたちはフラグメントを集めるのが優先。<CR>大体あなたは覚えてるの？
records.en_original: She can't help it. Our priority is to gather Fragments. Besides, do YOU know the whole thing?
records.en_auxiliary: She can't help it. Our priority is to gather Fragments. Besides, do YOU know the whole thing?
records.en: It can't be helped. Lime and the others have to prioritize gathering Fragments.<CR>Besides, have you memorized it?

records.jp: 当然でしょう？
records.en_original: Of course I do.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course I do.
records.en: Of course I do.

records.jp: 本当かしら……？
records.en_original: Oh really...?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh really?
records.en: Really...?

records.jp: じゃあさ！　覚えてるかクイズやろうよクイズ！<CR>それならはっきりするでしょ？
records.en_original: Ooh! Let's have a quiz to see if you really do know it! That'll clear things up, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh! Let's have a quiz to see if you really do know it! That'll clear things up, right?
records.en: Then let's have a quiz to see whether you remember it!<CR>That'll settle it, right?

records.jp: ……言ってみなさい
records.en_original: ...Try me.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Try me.
records.en: ...Go ahead.

records.jp: うわー、全部正解だよ
records.en_original: Wow, she got everything right.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, she got everything right.
records.en: Wow, she got every answer right.

records.jp: 台本のページ数まで覚えてるなんて……
records.en_original: She even knew the number of pages in the script...
records.en_auxiliary: She even knew the number of pages in the script.
records.en: She even knew the number of pages in the script...

records.jp: 私は斎木みたいに天才というわけではない。<CR>ただ反復して覚えただけ
records.en_original: I'm not a genius like Saiki. I just learned it all through repetition.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not a genius like Saiki. I just learned it all through repetition.
records.en: I'm not a genius like Saiki.<CR>I only memorized it through repetition.

records.jp: それに、他のセリフも覚えておかないと。<CR>舞台で他の人がミスした時カバーできないでしょう？
records.en_original: Besides, if you don't know the other actors' lines, you can't cover for them when they make a mistake.
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, if you don't know the other actors' lines, you can't cover for them when they make a mistake.
records.en: Besides, you need to memorize the other lines too.<CR>Otherwise you can't cover for someone if they make a mistake onstage.

records.jp: な、なるほど……
records.en_original: I-I see...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that makes sense.
records.en: I-I see...

records.jp: なるほどじゃないわよ。<CR>あなたもバレリーナならそれくらいわかってるでしょ？
records.en_original: What do you mean, "I see"? You were a ballerina; you should already know this.
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean, "makes sense"? You were a ballerina! You should already know this.
records.en: Don't say 'I see.'<CR>You were a ballerina, so you should already understand that much.

records.jp: うう……ごめん……
records.en_original: Er... Sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: Er, sorry.
records.en: Ugh... Sorry...

records.jp: （やっぱり、演劇のことについてはとことんストイックだなー）
records.en_original: (She's doesn't trifle when it comes to performing...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's doesn't mess around when it comes to performing.)
records.en: (She really is uncompromising when it comes to theater...)

records.jp: いい加減いいでしょ？　用が済んだのなら早く出なさい
records.en_original: Are you done yet? If you've got nothing else to say, hurry up and leave.
records.en_auxiliary: Are you done yet? If you've got nothing else to say, hurry up and leave.
records.en: That's enough, isn't it? If you're done, hurry up and leave.

records.jp: う、うん……
records.en_original: O-Okay...
records.en_auxiliary: O-okay.
records.en: O-Okay...

records.jp: （そんな言い方しなくてもいいのに……）
records.en_original: (She doesn't have to say it like that...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She doesn't have to be so brusque.)
records.en: (She doesn't have to say it like that...)

records.jp: それは――
records.en: That's—
